title: string length is computed with TypeScript UTF-16 semantics before encoding the Action input
notes:
specification/durable-execution.mdx:49 (Durable Boundary Contract): 'Every value crossing an Action or Flow persistence boundary MUST satisfy the compiler-checked durable codec contract.' The same rule as an-action-input-projection-the-descriptor-does-not-have-is-rejected, reached through a different durable kind. `.length` is legal TypeScript on a string exactly as it is on an array, so TypeScript refuses neither and the durable descriptor has to; the sentence then has to name the kind it could not project from rather than assuming the container it saw most often. This is the second of the three `cannot project <field> from durable <kind>` spellings the walk can produce (array, string, tuple); the tuple spelling is not in the corpus because reaching it needs a non-numeric key on a tuple, which is the same sentence through a third container and buys nothing the first two do not already hold. VERIFIED LOAD-BEARING, not assumed: four mutations run through both backends, each red on BOTH with the diff printed -- line 10 to 11, column 29 to 30, VIBE4110 to VIBE4111, and `durable string` to `durable array` in the fragment. That last mutation is the one this case is for, and it is mirrored: the array case's fragment mutated to `durable string` is red too, so the two cases discriminate each other and neither could be satisfied by an implementation that printed one fixed kind. The mutator refuses to run unless the case is green on both backends first AND its search string occurs exactly once in the file, and the file was restored and sha256-compared byte-identical after every one. NO MARKER on either backend: one diagnostic each, same code, line, column and sentence.

RETIRED 2026-09-05 by the implementation lane: §Flow (SA-2) requires ordinary locals, closures, calls, recursion and computed values, not Plan projections. The executable body compiler now uses checked transitive reachability and computes values before codec validation. The reference compiles and prints the declared descriptor marker. poc/src/durable/body-compiler.test.ts additionally executes the actual non-recursive corpus sources through live and replayed requests, checking their exact inputs and outputs with one worker call. The recursive fixture itself is intentionally not invoked; the same unit suite executes terminating recursion. The previous diagnostic is retained above as history, not a language restriction.

xfail.reason: The Go backend still refuses this ordinary Flow program through its legacy Plan/capture or transitive-Manifest limitation. The reference executable-body path now implements it. This marker records a missing implementation, not permission to weaken the Flow contract.
